Intel: chunk multi-function Python source into multiple pieces

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	tspack "github.com/xberg-io/tree-sitter-language-pack/packages/go"
)

func ptr[T any](value T) *T { return &value }
func main() {
	config := tspack.ProcessConfig{
		Language:     `python`,
		ChunkMaxSize: ptr(uint(30)),
	}
	result, err := tspack.Process(`def alpha():
    pass

def beta():
    pass

def gamma():
    pass

def delta():
    pass
`, config)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Language)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Metrics.TotalLines)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Chunks)
}
```
